answers.question: m167 beat 4 di, upper staff: every other reader TIES this G3 into the next note; the base (PlayScore) strikes it again. A tie is invisible to the note comparison — same measure, same onset, same pitch either way — so this was found by looking, not by counting. Which is on the page?
answers.answer: Physical P167 piano upper G3 eighth at q7/2 does not tie to P168 F#3. Printed incoming G3 tie connects P166 last G3 to P167 first G3. SmartScore native m167 is physical P166; preserve this address distinction.
